patch_resolves_note: The recorded fixed_commit and bundled patch.diff only change priority-string handling and test data outside lib/x509/pkcs12.c. The ARVO fixed image also does not provide usable Stage 04 assertion-side repair evidence for this PKCS#12 path, so the vulnerable-side mechanism is verified directly and the fixed-side limitation is recorded explicitly.

root_cause_criterion.description: The stack buffer `oid` must be initialized before it is used as a NUL-terminated C string for the later DATA_OID dispatch; otherwise bytes beyond the short asn1_read_value prefix remain undefined.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable trace records the declaration-side root event as zero_init=0 and reaches the protected strcmp dispatch. The staged fixed execution crashed before producing corresponding assertion events, so the missing initialization obligation is source-anchored but not differentially repair-verified here.

nodes.description: The DATA_OID strcmp dispatch compares 21 bytes while only 5 bytes of `oid` are defined for the witness, so the compare reads the uninitialized tail.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable trace records oid_dispatch.cmp_bytes=21 and oid_dispatch.oid_bytes_written=5.

edges.description: The 128-byte stack buffer declared as `oid` is only populated with the short returned OID text at the asn1_read_value site, leaving the remaining tail bytes undefined.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records oid_decl.sizeof_oid=128 > oid_read.oid_bytes_written=5.

edges.description: The same `oid` storage filled by asn1_read_value is passed unchanged to the later DATA_OID strcmp dispatch.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records the same oid pointer value at oid_read and oid_dispatch.
